workarounds.symptom: fix(review-context): build timeout is swallowed during grammar loading
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(review-context): don't swallow the build timeout during grammar loading. Target files: scripts/review_context/graph_bundle_ts.py, scripts/review_context/test_hardening.py. `tags_langs()` and the inherited-query loop in `Tags.__init__` both catch `Exception`, so when the `--timeout` alarm fires during grammar loading the `TimeoutError` gets swallowed and the build keeps going. I re-raise `TimeoutError` ahead of both handlers, like the issue suggests, and added `test_grammar_loading_does_not_swallow_the_timeout`, whi... (Ref: https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/4926)

workarounds.symptom: pr-agent v0.48.0: **GitLab webhooks backed by a secret provider need a new token format** ([#3913](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3913)): when GitLab credentials come from AWS Secrets
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **GitLab webhooks backed by a secret provider need a new token format** ([#3913](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3913)): when GitLab credentials come from AWS Secrets Manager or Google Cloud Storage, the webhook's Secret Token must be `<secret-name>:<webhook-token>`. Name-only tokens are rejected with HTTP 401, so update the webhooks when you deploy.. Upstream PR #3913. (Ref: https://github.com/Codium-ai/pr-agent/pull/3913)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Server webhooks require credentials** ([#3911](https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent/pull/3911)): with `azure_devops_server.webhook_username`/`webhook_password` or `bitbucket_server.webhook_secret` unset, every webhook is rejected with HTTP 403.
